name: smwmusic-super-mario-world-pirate-yoshi-s-island
title: Super Mario World (Pirate) - Yoshi's Island
description:
A fairly accurate port of the Yoshi's Island theme from the Pirated version of Super Mario World (SMW for short).

Can be used in well, Yoshi's Island, or just overworlds in general.

Special thanks to PalaceSwitcher for the Midi.

Edit: Added Tremolo to make it more accurate.
